groups.name: Authentication and profile
groups.description: Account registration, session tokens, the authenticated profile, phone verification and medical-record editing. All /me endpoints require a Bearer access token.

endpoints.name: Register a patient account
endpoints.summary: Create a patient account and issue a token pair.
endpoints.description: Creates an ACTIVE account, assigns the PATIENT role, creates a patient profile and optionally stores date_of_birth as a field value. Email is trimmed and lower-cased. A duplicate email returns 409 email_taken.

bodyFields.name: firstName
bodyFields.description: 1-100 characters after trimming.

bodyFields.name: lastName
bodyFields.description: 1-100 characters after trimming.

bodyFields.name: email
bodyFields.description: Valid email, max 320 characters. Stored lower-case.

bodyFields.name: password
bodyFields.description: 8-128 characters.

bodyFields.name: password_confirmation
bodyFields.description: Must match password.

bodyFields.name: dob
bodyFields.description: ISO date; stored as a date_of_birth field value when the definition exists.

bodyFields.name: phone
bodyFields.description: E.164 phone, for example +2348012345678. Only the phone digest is stored.

responses.label: Created
responses.description: Account, assigned roles and a fresh token pair.

responses.label: Bad Request
responses.description: Zod validation issues, one entry per invalid field.

issues.message: String must contain at least 1 character(s)
String must contain at least 1 character(s)
String must contain at least 8 character(s)

responses.label: Conflict
responses.description: The email is already registered.

notes: Access tokens expire in 900 seconds; refresh tokens expire in about 30 days.
The access token is a JWT whose roles are read from the database on every request.

endpoints.name: Log in
endpoints.summary: Exchange email and password for a token pair.
endpoints.description: Looks up the account by lower-cased email, verifies the bcrypt password hash and issues a new session. Returns 401 invalid_credentials for an unknown email or bad password and 403 account_inactive for a non-ACTIVE account.

bodyFields.name: email
bodyFields.description: Registered email; trimmed and lower-cased.

bodyFields.name: password
bodyFields.description: 1-128 characters.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Account summary for the seeded demo patient, current roles and a new token pair. Tokens are placeholders.

responses.label: Unauthorized
responses.description: Unknown email or wrong password; the message is intentionally identical for both.

notes: Uses the seeded demo patient (demo.patient@example.test). Run npm run db:seed if the account is missing.
Roles in the access token are the roles returned by this call.
The 200 example shows the demo account; captured access and refresh tokens are replaced with placeholders.

endpoints.name: Rotate a refresh token
endpoints.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair.
endpoints.description: Refresh tokens are single-use: a successful call replaces the stored hash, so the submitted refresh token can no longer be used. Returns 401 invalid_refresh_token when the token is unknown, revoked, expired or the account is not ACTIVE.

bodyFields.name: refresh_token
bodyFields.description: Opaque refresh token from register/login/refresh.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: A new token pair; the previous refresh token is invalidated.

notes: Persist the returned refresh_token immediately; the submitted one stops working.

endpoints.name: Log out
endpoints.summary: Revoke a refresh token and its session.
endpoints.description: Marks the session matching the refresh token as revoked. The call returns 204 whether or not a matching active session existed. Access tokens for the revoked session stop passing requireAuth immediately because the session is checked on every request.

bodyFields.name: refresh_token
bodyFields.description: Refresh token to revoke.

responses.label: No Content
responses.description: Session revoked; the response has no body.

notes: Drop both tokens client-side after this call.

endpoints.name: Get the current profile
endpoints.summary: Return account, roles, patient profile and stored field values.
endpoints.description: Loads the account summary, roles, patient profile metadata, flattened field_values, the field list with labels and value types, allergy records, medical events and a presigned avatar_url when storage is configured.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Current account, profile and medical data.

notes: field_values is a convenience map of field key to stored JSON value; fields carries labels and types.
avatar_url is null when no avatar is stored or S3 is not configured.

endpoints.name: Update the current profile
endpoints.summary: Partially update account and patient fields.
endpoints.description: Updates the account display name from firstName/lastName, email, phone digest, password and any provided patient fields. Only field keys present in field_definitions are written, so city/state/country are silently skipped when no definition exists. Returns the full profile payload.

bodyFields.name: firstName
bodyFields.description: Updates display_name and full_name.

bodyFields.name: lastName
bodyFields.description: Updates display_name and full_name.

bodyFields.name: email
bodyFields.description: New unique email; clears email_verified_at when changed.

bodyFields.name: phone
bodyFields.description: E.164 phone; clears phone_verified_at when the digest changes.

bodyFields.name: dob
bodyFields.description: ISO date stored as date_of_birth.

bodyFields.name: city
bodyFields.description: Stored only when a matching field definition exists.

bodyFields.name: state
bodyFields.description: Stored only when a matching field definition exists.

bodyFields.name: country
bodyFields.description: Stored only when a matching field definition exists.

bodyFields.name: password
bodyFields.description: 8-128 characters; rehashed with bcrypt.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: The full profile payload after the patch.

notes: Returns 409 email_taken when the new email belongs to another account.

endpoints.name: Replace medical details
endpoints.summary: Upsert medical fields and replace allergies and medical events.
endpoints.description: Writes height, weight, gender, blood type, genotype, blood pressure, conditions, medications and emergency contacts as field values. When allergies or medicalEvents are arrays they replace all existing rows for the patient. Severity is normalised to MILD, MODERATE or SEVERE. Returns the full profile payload.

bodyFields.name: height
bodyFields.description: Stored as the height field value.

bodyFields.name: weight
bodyFields.description: Stored as the weight field value.

bodyFields.name: gender
bodyFields.description: Max 200 characters.

bodyFields.name: bloodType
bodyFields.description: Stored under the blood_group field key.

bodyFields.name: genoType
bodyFields.description: Stored under the genotype field key.

bodyFields.name: bloodPressure
bodyFields.description: Stored under blood_pressure.

bodyFields.name: existingMedicalConditions
bodyFields.description: Stored under conditions.

bodyFields.name: existingMedications
bodyFields.description: Stored under current_medications.

bodyFields.name: emergencyContactName
bodyFields.description: Max 200 characters.

bodyFields.name: emergencyContactPhone
bodyFields.description: Max 200 characters.

bodyFields.name: allergies
bodyFields.description: Array of {name, severity?, diagnosisDate?}; replaces all allergy rows.

bodyFields.name: medicalEvents
bodyFields.description: Array of {name, recoveryTime?, occurredOn?|date?, description?}; replaces all event rows.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: The full profile payload with the new allergies and medical events.

endpoints.curl: curl -sS -X PUT http://localhost:3000/v1/me/medical -H 'authorization: Bearer <access-jwt>' -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"height":170,"weight":68,"gender":"Female","bloodType":"O+","genoType":"AA","bloodPressure":"118/76","existingMedicalConditions":["Hypertension"],"existingMedications":["Amlodipine 5mg daily"],"emergencyContactName":"Ngozi Okafor","emergencyContactPhone":"+2348012345679","allergies":[{"name":"Penicillin","severity":"severe","diagnosisDate":"2015-06-01"},{"name":"Peanuts","severity":"MILD"}],"medicalEvents":[{"name":"Appendectomy","recoveryTime":"2 weeks","occurredOn":"2019-03-14","description":"Laparoscopic appendectomy, no complications."},{"name":"Malaria","recoveryTime":"5 days","occurredOn":"2022-08-02","description":"Treated with artemether-lumefantrine."}]}'
notes: Omitted arrays leave existing allergy/event rows untouched; empty arrays delete them.

endpoints.name: Upload an avatar
endpoints.summary: Upload a profile image as multipart/form-data.
endpoints.description: Accepts one image field, resizes it to 500px wide WebP and stores it in S3. This environment has no S3 credentials configured, so the endpoint returns 503 storage_unavailable before reading the file. A missing file returns 400 image_required when storage is configured.

bodyFields.name: image
bodyFields.description: Image file up to 5 MB.

responses.label: Service Unavailable
responses.description: Object storage is not configured in this environment.

notes: Success response when storage is configured: { "avatar_key": "avatars/<account-id>.webp", "avatar_url": "<presigned-url>" }.
Multer errors are reported as 400 invalid_upload.

endpoints.name: Delete an allergy
endpoints.summary: Remove one allergy record owned by the current patient.
endpoints.description: Deletes the allergy only when it belongs to the current patient. Returns 404 not_found otherwise.

pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: Allergy id from GET /me or PUT /me/medical.

responses.label: No Content
responses.description: Allergy removed; no body.

notes: Use the allergy id captured from the preceding GET /me response.

endpoints.name: Delete a medical event
endpoints.summary: Remove one medical event owned by the current patient.
endpoints.description: Deletes the event only when it belongs to the current patient. Returns 404 not_found otherwise.

pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: Medical event id from GET /me or PUT /me/medical.

responses.label: No Content
responses.description: Medical event removed; no body.

notes: Use the event id captured from the preceding GET /me response.

endpoints.name: Update a medical event
endpoints.summary: Partially update one medical event.
endpoints.description: Updates name, recoveryTime, occurredOn/date and description on an event owned by the current patient. An empty patch returns 400 no_changes. Returns { event } with the updated row.

bodyExample.name: Appendectomy (updated)
bodyExample.description: Laparoscopic appendectomy; extended recovery recorded during capture.

bodyFields.name: name
bodyFields.description: 1-100 characters.

bodyFields.name: recoveryTime
bodyFields.description: Max 200 characters; null clears it.

bodyFields.name: occurredOn
bodyFields.description: ISO date; alias date is also accepted.

bodyFields.name: description
bodyFields.description: Max 4000 characters; null clears it.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: The updated medical event.

event.name: Appendectomy (updated)
event.description: Laparoscopic appendectomy; extended recovery recorded during capture.

endpoints.curl: curl -sS -X PATCH http://localhost:3000/v1/me/medical-events/f65c5648-6f40-4307-bd06-21e4a8174137 -H 'authorization: Bearer <access-jwt>' -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"name":"Appendectomy (updated)","recoveryTime":"3 weeks","description":"Laparoscopic appendectomy; extended recovery recorded during capture."}'
notes: An empty object returns 400 no_changes.

endpoints.name: Begin phone verification
endpoints.summary: Queue a six-digit SMS verification code.
endpoints.description: Consumes any previous unconsumed PHONE_VERIFICATION challenge for the account, creates a new challenge with a 10-minute expiry and queues the SMS through the outbox. The code is never returned by the API.

bodyFields.name: phone
bodyFields.description: E.164 phone, 8-15 digits after the plus.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Code queued; expires_in is 600 seconds.

notes: Returns 503 sms_unavailable if the outbox write fails.

endpoints.name: Confirm phone verification
endpoints.summary: Verify the SMS code and activate a channel link.
endpoints.description: Checks the latest unconsumed challenge for the phone digest. A correct code marks the account phone as verified and creates or reactivates a ChannelLink for the patient. A wrong code increments attempts and returns 400 invalid_code; after five attempts the challenge is unusable.

bodyFields.name: phone
bodyFields.description: Same E.164 phone used in /auth/phone/begin.

bodyFields.name: code
bodyFields.description: Six digits from the queued SMS.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Phone verified and channel link created.

responses.label: Bad Request
responses.description: Wrong, expired or exhausted verification code.

notes: OTP values are only available in the SMS outbox and must never be returned to clients.
A verified phone is required before SMS/USSD consent endpoints can create a consent.

groups.name: Patient portal and protected records
groups.description: Patient-controlled field sharing, emergency profile, patient codes, access grants, consent channels, audit history and practitioner record access.

endpoints.name: Get field state
endpoints.summary: Return the profile version and every active field definition with its stored value.
endpoints.description: Lists active field definitions ordered by sort_order and field_key. value and field_version are null when the patient has not stored that field. version is the patient profile version used for optimistic concurrency.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Profile version plus all active fields.

notes: Send the returned version as expected_version on the next write.

endpoints.name: Update field values
endpoints.summary: Upsert one or more field values with optimistic concurrency.
endpoints.description: Every key must be an active field definition and no value may be null. The patient profile version is incremented only when expected_version matches, otherwise 409 version_conflict is returned. Returns the full field state after the write.

bodyFields.name: fields
bodyFields.description: Map of field_key to non-null JSON value.

bodyFields.name: expected_version
bodyFields.description: Current patient profile version; non-negative.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: The full field state with the incremented version.

endpoints.curl: curl -sS -X PUT http://localhost:3000/v1/me/fields -H 'authorization: Bearer <access-jwt>' -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"fields":{"full_name":"Bola Adeyemi","date_of_birth":"1994-11-03","allergies":["Penicillin"],"current_medications":["Paracetamol as needed"],"conditions":["Asthma"],"blood_group":"O+","emergency_contact_name":"Tunde Adeyemi","emergency_contact_phone":"+2348098765433","weight":"64","height":"168","gender":"Female"},"expected_version":1}'
notes: 400 invalid_fields when fields is empty, 400 invalid_value for null values, 400 invalid_field for unknown or inactive keys.
409 version_conflict when expected_version is stale.

endpoints.name: Set emergency fields
endpoints.summary: Replace the ordered list of fields shown in an emergency read.
endpoints.description: Each key must be unique, active, emergency_eligible and already have a stored value. The write replaces the whole emergency field list and increments the patient profile version when expected_version matches.

bodyFields.name: field_keys
bodyFields.description: Up to 50 unique emergency-eligible field keys with stored values.

bodyFields.name: expected_version
bodyFields.description: Current patient profile version.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: The new profile version and ordered field keys.

notes: 400 invalid_field when a key is duplicated, inactive, not emergency-eligible or has no stored value.

endpoints.name: Get emergency summary
endpoints.summary: Preview the emergency projection shown to a reader.
endpoints.description: Returns the current profile version, the ordered emergency field keys and the projected key, label and value for each field. available is false when no emergency fields are configured.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Emergency projection preview.

endpoints.name: Get patient code
endpoints.summary: Return the current 12-digit patient code.
endpoints.description: Creates a patient code on first use. The code is stored encrypted and only its digest is indexed. code_version increments on every rotation.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: The current code, version and last rotation time.

notes: The example replaces the live code with <patient-code>; the real value is 12 numeric digits.

endpoints.name: Rotate patient code
endpoints.summary: Generate a new patient code and revoke active grants.
endpoints.description: Increments code_version, replaces the digest and ciphertext, and revokes every active access grant and read session for the patient. Returns the new code, which must be shared again with practitioners.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: New code and incremented code_version.

notes: All outstanding grant codes and read sessions stop working immediately.

endpoints.name: List access grants
endpoints.summary: List grants created by the patient, newest first.
endpoints.description: Returns grant id/grant_id, derived status (active, expired or revoked), expiry, revocation time, creation time, sorted field keys and channels. limit is clamped to 1-100 and defaults to 50.

queryParams.name: limit
queryParams.description: 1-100; values outside the range are clamped.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Active and revoked grants.

notes: status is computed at read time from revoked_at and expires_at.

endpoints.name: Create an access grant
endpoints.summary: Create a short-lived grant code for selected fields.
endpoints.description: Validates that every field key is active, de-duplicates keys and channels, and creates an access grant with an 8-digit numeric code. The code is returned once in this response and is only stored as a digest. expires_in_minutes defaults to 30 and is capped at 1440.

bodyFields.name: field_keys
bodyFields.description: 1-50 active field keys.

bodyFields.name: channels
bodyFields.description: Subset of WEB_PRACTITIONER and USSD; defaults to ["WEB_PRACTITIONER"].

bodyFields.name: expires_in_minutes
bodyFields.description: 1-1440; defaults to 30.

responses.label: Created
responses.description: Grant metadata and the one-time grant code.

notes: The example replaces the live grant code with <grant-code>; the real value is 8 numeric digits.
400 invalid_field when any key is unknown or inactive.

endpoints.name: Revoke an access grant
endpoints.summary: Revoke a grant and its active read sessions.
endpoints.description: Marks the grant revoked, increments its version and revokes every read session created from it. Returns 404 not_found when the grant does not belong to the patient.

pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: Grant id from POST or GET /me/grants.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: The grant is revoked.

notes: Revocation is idempotent from the client point of view; the endpoint reports revoked true.

endpoints.name: List access events
endpoints.summary: Return the patient audit trail, newest first.
endpoints.description: Lists audit events whose patient_id is the current patient. Each entry exposes the channel, action, outcome, optional reason_code, resource type/id and affected field keys. limit is clamped to 1-100 and defaults to 50.

queryParams.name: limit
queryParams.description: 1-100; values outside the range are clamped.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Audit events for the current patient.

notes: id is a decimal string because audit ids are big integers.

endpoints.name: Create or replace a consent
endpoints.summary: Grant SMS or USSD use of selected fields through a verified phone link.
endpoints.description: Requires an active ChannelLink for the patient. phone_link_id may select a specific link, otherwise the newest active link is used. Replaces the consent field list, reactivates a revoked consent and increments its version. expires_in_minutes defaults to 30 days.

bodyFields.name: phone_link_id
bodyFields.description: Specific active ChannelLink; defaults to the newest active link.

bodyFields.name: field_keys
bodyFields.description: 1-50 active field keys.

bodyFields.name: expires_in_minutes
bodyFields.description: 1-525600; defaults to 43200 (30 days).

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Consent metadata and version.

responses.label: Bad Request
responses.description: No active ChannelLink exists for the patient.

body.message: An active channel link is required for this consent

notes: 400 invalid_channel for anything other than SMS/USSD.
Complete /auth/phone/begin and /auth/phone/confirm first to create a ChannelLink.

endpoints.name: Revoke a consent
endpoints.summary: Revoke the patient consent for one channel.
endpoints.description: Marks the active consent for the channel as revoked and increments its version. Returns available true and revoked true even when no active consent existed.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Consent revoked.

notes: 400 invalid_channel for unsupported channels.

endpoints.name: Read an emergency profile
endpoints.summary: Look up a patient emergency projection by 12-digit patient code.
endpoints.description: Any authenticated account can attempt an emergency read. A valid 12-digit code returns the ordered emergency projection. Invalid, unknown or unconfigured codes return 200 with available false. Five denied attempts in ten minutes throttle the account and also return available false.

bodyFields.name: patient_code
bodyFields.description: 1-32 characters; must be 12 digits to match.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Emergency projection for the demo patient.

notes: Denied and throttled reads are audited and return { "available": false } with status 200.
The demo patient code 123456789012 is public demo data.

endpoints.name: Open a grant read session
endpoints.summary: Practitioner opens a grant and receives a 15-minute read session.
endpoints.description: Requires the PRACTITIONER role and an APPROVED practitioner_profiles row; otherwise 403 forbidden. Validates the patient code and an active, unrevoked, unexpired grant that includes the WEB_PRACTITIONER channel. Creates or refreshes a read session capped at 15 minutes and at the grant expiry, then returns the field projection with grant_id, read_session_id and expires_at.

bodyFields.name: patient_code
bodyFields.description: 12-digit patient code shared by the patient.

bodyFields.name: grant_code
bodyFields.description: 8-digit grant code returned by POST /me/grants.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Projection plus grant and read-session identifiers.

responses.label: Forbidden
responses.description: The caller is not an approved practitioner.

responses.label: Bad Request
responses.description: Required body fields are missing.

notes: Invalid codes, unknown patients, unavailable grants or the wrong channel return 200 with { "available": false }.
Five denied attempts in ten minutes throttle the practitioner and return available false.

endpoints.name: Read an open grant session
endpoints.summary: Re-read the projection for an active read session.
endpoints.description: The read session must belong to the current account and auth session, be unrevoked and unexpired, and its grant must still be live. Returns the projection with grant_id, read_session_id and the earlier of the session and grant expiry. Returns available false when the session is no longer usable.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: The same projection as the open call.

notes: The auth session id is part of the lookup, so logging out invalidates the read session.

endpoints.name: Close a grant session
endpoints.summary: Revoke a read session before it expires.
endpoints.description: Finds the read session for the current account and auth session and marks it revoked. Repeated calls return the original revoked_at. Returns 404 not_found when the session does not belong to the caller.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: The read session is closed.

groups.name: Directory
groups.description: Public directory of active services, Nigerian areas and approved facilities. No authentication required.

endpoints.name: List services
endpoints.summary: List active service codes.
endpoints.description: Returns active services ordered by sort_order and service_code.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Active services.

endpoints.name: Search areas
endpoints.summary: Search Nigerian areas by name, city, region or alias.
endpoints.description: Exact matches are returned before prefix matches, de-duplicated by id. Only active NG areas are considered. limit is clamped to 1-10 and defaults to 5.

queryParams.name: q
queryParams.description: Search term, max 120 characters. Omit to list the first areas alphabetically.

queryParams.name: limit
queryParams.description: 1-10; values outside the range are clamped.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Matching areas.

endpoints.name: Find facilities by service
endpoints.summary: Find approved facilities offering a service near an area.
endpoints.description: Requires service and area_id. Approved facilities with an approved service entry are measured from the area centre and filtered by radius_km. Results are sorted by distance then name. limit is clamped to 1-10 and defaults to 3; radius_km is clamped to 1-200 and defaults to 25.

queryParams.name: service
queryParams.description: Service code such as general, pediatrics or maternity.

queryParams.name: limit
queryParams.description: 1-10; values outside the range are clamped.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Matching facilities with distance_km.

responses.label: Bad Request
responses.description: Both required query parameters are missing.

responses.label: Bad Request
responses.description: area_id is missing.

notes: Unknown area ids return an empty array, not 404.

endpoints.name: Get a facility
endpoints.summary: Return one approved facility with its approved services.
endpoints.description: Returns the facility address, area, coordinates, verification timestamps, source trust tier and the sorted list of approved active services. Returns 404 not_found when the facility is missing or not APPROVED.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Facility detail with approved services.

notes: latitude and longitude are numbers or null.

groups.name: Symptom analysis
groups.description: AI-assisted symptom intake. Each create or follow-up request makes a real model call, then returns the stored symptom record and conversation. Records are scoped to the authenticated account; ids that do not belong to the caller return 404 so ownership is not disclosed.

endpoints.name: Create a symptom analysis
endpoints.summary: Send a symptom description with optional attachments and receive an AI assessment.
endpoints.description: multipart/form-data. Creates a symptom record for the authenticated account's patient profile, stores up to five attachments, runs the symptom agent with the patient's context, and returns the full conversation. The agent may set the record's name, severity and summary. Attachments must be image/* or application/pdf, max 10 MB each and max 5 files. Accounts without a patient profile get 404 not_found. When the AI provider is unconfigured the endpoint returns 503 ai_unavailable and removes the half-created record.

bodyFields.name: message
bodyFields.description: Symptom description, trimmed length 1-8000 characters.

bodyFields.name: includeRecords
bodyFields.description: Include the patient's stored records and reviewed facility content in the AI context. Accepts true/false/1/0/yes/no/on/off. Default true.

bodyFields.name: modifyHistory
bodyFields.description: Allow the agent to update the stored name, severity and summary. Default true.

bodyFields.name: language
bodyFields.description: Language code for this conversation (for example en, pcm, yo, ha, ig). Defaults to the profile's preferred language, then en.

bodyFields.name: images
bodyFields.description: 0-5 repeated parts, each an image/* or application/pdf file up to 10 MB. No file is embedded in this fixture.

responses.label: Created
responses.description: Stored symptom record plus the full AI thread (Human message and AI reply).

symptom.name: Mild headache and runny nose
symptom.summary: Mild headache and runny nose for two days.

messages.content: I have had a mild headache and a runny nose for two days.

A mild headache with a runny nose for two days is often due to a common viral infection, though other causes are possible.

- Rest, drink fluids, and try saline nasal spray or a humidifier.
- For the headache, you can consider an over-the-counter pain reliever if it’s normally safe for you; follow the label and check with a pharmacist if you’re unsure whether it’s suitable with your medicines or allergies.
- Consider a COVID test, especially if you’ve had an exposure or will be around someone at higher risk.

Seek urgent care for a sudden or severe headache, confusion, weakness, stiff neck, trouble breathing, or other rapidly worsening symptoms. Contact a healthcare professional if symptoms worsen or aren’t improving after about 10 days.

endpoints.curl:
TOKEN="<access-jwt>"
curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:3000/v1/symptom \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -F 'message=I have had a mild headache and a runny nose for two days.' \
  -F 'includeRecords=true' \
  -F 'modifyHistory=true'
notes: Captured live: 201 in 15.8 s with model_version "openrouter" (server model openai/gpt-6-luna).
messages is the whole thread on create: the Human message followed by the AI reply, which uses Markdown.
files lists object-storage keys for attachments and is [] when none were sent.
The request is synchronous; allow at least 180 s in client code.

endpoints.name: List symptom analyses
endpoints.summary: Paginated list of the caller's symptom records, newest first.
endpoints.description: Returns records scoped to the authenticated account, ordered by created_at descending.

queryParams.name: page
queryParams.description: 1-based page. Non-numeric or < 1 falls back to 1; capped at 100000.

queryParams.name: limit
queryParams.description: Page size 1-100. Values above 100 are clamped to 100.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Current page of symptom records.

symptoms.name: Mild headache and runny nose
symptoms.summary: Mild headache and runny nose for two days.

responses.label: Unauthorized
responses.description: Captured with the Authorization header omitted.

notes: totalPages is 0 when total is 0.
Pagination fields (page, limit, total, totalPages) sit beside the symptoms array at the top level.

endpoints.name: Get one symptom analysis
endpoints.summary: Fetch a symptom record and its stored AI conversation.
endpoints.description: Loads the record and its LangGraph thread history. A malformed uuid, an unknown id, or a record owned by another account all return 404 not_found.

pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: Symptom analysis id returned by POST /symptom.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Record plus the stored conversation history.

symptom.name: Mild headache and runny nose
symptom.summary: Mild headache and runny nose for two days.

messages.content: I have had a mild headache and a runny nose for two days.

A mild headache with a runny nose for two days is often due to a common viral infection, though other causes are possible.

- Rest, drink fluids, and try saline nasal spray or a humidifier.
- For the headache, you can consider an over-the-counter pain reliever if it’s normally safe for you; follow the label and check with a pharmacist if you’re unsure whether it’s suitable with your medicines or allergies.
- Consider a COVID test, especially if you’ve had an exposure or will be around someone at higher risk.

Seek urgent care for a sudden or severe headache, confusion, weakness, stiff neck, trouble breathing, or other rapidly worsening symptoms. Contact a healthcare professional if symptoms worsen or aren’t improving after about 10 days.

responses.label: Not found
responses.description: Captured with a valid-format uuid that belongs to no record visible to this account.

notes: Non-uuid ids return the same 404 body as unknown ids rather than a 400.
messages is the stored thread for the record and grows with each follow-up.

endpoints.name: Continue a symptom conversation
endpoints.summary: Ask a follow-up question in an existing symptom thread.
endpoints.description: Uses the record's stored includeRecords/modifyHistory settings and the same multipart rules as create. Attachments are appended to the record's files. Unlike create, the response contains only the last two messages: the new Human message and the AI reply.

bodyFields.name: message
bodyFields.description: Follow-up text, trimmed length 1-8000 characters.

bodyFields.name: images
bodyFields.description: 0-5 image/* or application/pdf parts, max 10 MB each. No file is embedded here.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Updated record plus the last two thread messages.

symptom.name: Mild headache and runny nose
symptom.summary: Mild headache and runny nose for two days; headache gets a little worse in the evening.

messages.content: Should I be worried if the headache gets a little worse in the evening?

A slight increase in the evening **isn’t necessarily a reason to worry**. Tiredness, not drinking enough, or nasal congestion can make a mild headache feel more noticeable later in the day.

Try drinking fluids, resting, and using saline spray; notice whether anything seems to trigger or relieve it. Seek urgent care for a sudden or severe headache, confusion, weakness or numbness, vision changes, a stiff neck with fever, or repeated vomiting. If it keeps worsening or isn’t improving over the next several days, contact a healthcare professional.

endpoints.curl:
TOKEN="<access-jwt>"
SYMPTOM_ID=<symptom-id>
curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:3000/v1/symptom/$SYMPTOM_ID/follow-up \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -F 'message=Should I be worried if the headache gets a little worse in the evening?'
notes: The agent may rewrite name, severity and summary; check symptom.updated_at.
Unknown or foreign ids return 404 before any model call is made.
Requires a configured AI provider; otherwise 503 ai_unavailable.

endpoints.summary: Correct the stored name and/or severity without calling the model.
endpoints.description: Accepts name and/or severity only. Unknown keys are rejected with 400 validation_error, and an empty object returns 400 invalid_update.

bodyFields.name: name
bodyFields.description: New title, 1-200 characters. Omit to leave unchanged.

bodyFields.name: severity
bodyFields.description: MILD, MODERATE or SEVERE (case-insensitive). Omit to leave unchanged.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: The updated symptom record.

symptom.name: Headache and runny nose (day 2)

endpoints.name: Delete a symptom analysis
endpoints.summary: Delete a record, its attachments and its AI thread.
endpoints.description: Removes the row, deletes stored attachments, clears the AI thread history and returns {deleted:true}. Unknown or foreign ids return 404 not_found.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Deletion confirmed.

notes: The captured record was deleted after this call, so its id now returns 404.

groups.name: Medications and reminders
groups.description: Medication schedules, per-dose moments and device registration. All schedule and moment routes resolve the patient from the bearer token; a body patient id is never accepted. Numeric progress/score fields are Decimal strings, not JSON numbers.

endpoints.name: Create a structured medication schedule
endpoints.summary: Create a schedule from an explicit medication array without an AI call.
endpoints.description: Deterministic path: a non-empty medications array of structured entries skips the model. The API creates the schedule and one moment per dose per day between startDate and endDate. The response contains the schedule but no moments; read them with GET /medications/:id. Date-only inputs are interpreted as the same calendar date in UTC: startDate 2026-11-17 is returned as start_date 2026-11-17T00:00:00.000Z and endDate 2026-11-19 as end_date 2026-11-19T00:00:00.000Z. Dose moments are absolute instants; render them in the user's local timezone.

bodyExample.title: Headache relief plan
bodyExample.summary: Paracetamol 500 mg up to three times daily for two days

bodyFields.name: title
bodyFields.description: Schedule title. Stored as null when omitted.

bodyFields.name: description
bodyFields.description: Free-text description. Stored as null when omitted.

bodyFields.name: summary
bodyFields.description: Short summary. When omitted it is generated as "<drug> <dose>, ...".

bodyFields.name: startDate
bodyFields.description: ISO date; day precision. Must not be after endDate.

bodyFields.name: endDate
bodyFields.description: ISO date; day precision, inclusive for moment generation.

bodyFields.name: medications
bodyFields.description: At least one entry: {drug (required), dose, frequency, times: [{hour 0-23, minute 0-59}] (at least one)}. A malformed structured array returns 400 instead of falling back to the AI path.

responses.label: Created
responses.description: Schedule row; moments are created but not included.

schedule.title: Headache relief plan
schedule.summary: Paracetamol 500 mg up to three times daily for two days

responses.label: Invalid schedule
responses.description: endDate precedes startDate.

body.message: End date must not precede start date

responses.label: Invalid schedule
responses.description: Empty medications array.

body.message: Medications or a document is required

endpoints.curl:
TOKEN="<access-jwt>"
curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:3000/v1/medications \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"title":"Headache relief plan","description":"Short course for tension headache","summary":"Paracetamol 500 mg up to three times daily for two days","startDate":"2026-11-17","endDate":"2026-11-19","medications":[{"drug":"Paracetamol","dose":"500 mg","frequency":"Three times daily","times":[{"hour":8,"minute":0},{"hour":14,"minute":0},{"hour":20,"minute":0}]}]}'
notes: Captured live: 201 in 29 ms; no model call on this path.
progress and score are strings: the capture is progress "0", score "100".
progress only counts decided moments (TAKEN or MISSED), so it stays 0 while every moment is PENDING.
The captured start_date/end_date round-trip the input calendar dates: 2026-11-17T00:00:00.000Z and 2026-11-19T00:00:00.000Z.

endpoints.name: Create a schedule from free text (AI-assisted)
endpoints.summary: Let the scheduler model turn unstructured text or a document into a schedule.
endpoints.description: Used when medications is free text (or absent and a document is uploaded). The API calls the medication scheduler agent and persists its JSON draft. Explicit title/description/summary override the model's values. The same route accepts multipart/form-data with a single document file (max 10 MB) instead of JSON.

bodyExample.medications: Amoxicillin 500 mg three times daily for four days

bodyFields.name: startDate
bodyFields.description: ISO date; day precision.

bodyFields.name: endDate
bodyFields.description: ISO date; must not precede startDate.

bodyFields.name: medications
bodyFields.description: Free-text medication instructions. Required unless a document part is uploaded; a structured array takes the deterministic path instead.

bodyFields.name: document
bodyFields.description: multipart/form-data only: one file up to 10 MB. Not embedded in this fixture.

bodyFields.name: title
bodyFields.description: Optional override of the model-generated title.

bodyFields.name: description
bodyFields.description: Optional override of the model-generated description.

bodyFields.name: summary
bodyFields.description: Optional override of the model-generated summary.

responses.label: Created (AI-assisted)
responses.description: Schedule built from the model draft; the model filled title and summary.

schedule.summary: Take amoxicillin 500 mg three times daily for four days, from November 17 through November 20, 2026.

endpoints.curl:
TOKEN="<access-jwt>"
curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:3000/v1/medications \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"startDate":"2026-11-17","endDate":"2026-11-20","medications":"Amoxicillin 500 mg three times daily for four days"}'
notes: Captured live: 201 in 5.5 s against OpenRouter (openai/gpt-6-luna).

The draft returned title null, description null and summary "Take amoxicillin 500 mg three times daily for four days, from November 17 through November 20, 2026."; the schedule dates round-tripped as 2026-11-17T00:00:00.000Z and 2026-11-20T00:00:00.000Z.
Model output is not clinically validated; review drug, dose and times before use.
Missing provider config returns 503 ai_unavailable; invalid model JSON returns 502 ai_invalid_response.
The schedule response does not include model_version; the AI write is recorded in the audit log as actorRef ai:<model>.

endpoints.name: List medication schedules
endpoints.summary: Paginated schedules for the authenticated patient, newest first.
endpoints.description: Returns schedule rows without moments, ordered by created_at descending.

queryParams.name: page
queryParams.description: 1-based page; invalid values fall back to 1.

queryParams.name: limit
queryParams.description: Page size; values above 50 are clamped to 50.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Current page of schedules.

schedules.title: Headache relief plan
schedules.summary: Paracetamol 500 mg up to three times daily for two days

notes: totalPages is Math.ceil(total / limit), so it is 0 when there are no schedules.
Schedules require a patient profile; accounts without one get 403 patient_profile_required.

endpoints.name: Get one medication schedule
endpoints.summary: Fetch a schedule with all of its dose moments, ordered by time.
endpoints.description: Returns the schedule plus moments (time, drug, dose, frequency, status, notification flags). Unknown ids, non-uuid ids and other patients' schedules return 404 not_found.

pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: Medication schedule id returned by POST /medications.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Schedule with nine PENDING moments for three days at three times daily.

schedule.title: Headache relief plan
schedule.summary: Paracetamol 500 mg up to three times daily for two days

notes: moments are sorted by time ascending, not by drug.
moment.time is an absolute instant. The 8:00 dose is stored as 07:00:00.000Z, so render moments in the user's local timezone instead of slicing the UTC string.
In the capture notified_user is false and notified_at is null because no reminder cycle had processed these future moments.

endpoints.name: Mark a dose moment
endpoints.summary: Set one dose moment to TAKEN, MISSED or PENDING and recompute schedule progress.
endpoints.description: Updates the moment by id, then recomputes the parent schedule's progress and score. The response includes the updated moment plus both recomputed values.

pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: Moment id (medication_moments.id), not the schedule id.

bodyFields.name: status
bodyFields.description: TAKEN, MISSED or PENDING (uppercase enum).

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Updated moment plus the parent schedule's progress and score.

endpoints.curl:
TOKEN="<access-jwt>"
MOMENT_ID=<moment-id>
curl -sS -X PATCH http://localhost:3000/v1/medications/moments/$MOMENT_ID \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"status":"TAKEN"}'
notes: progress is taken / (taken + missed) as a percentage with up to two decimals; one TAKEN and no MISSED yields 100 while remaining moments are still PENDING.
Both progress and score are Decimal strings in JSON, for example "100".
A moment owned by another patient returns 404 not_found.

endpoints.name: Add medications to a schedule
endpoints.summary: Append structured medications and create their new dose moments.
endpoints.description: Appends to the schedule's medications JSON and creates new PENDING moments for the supplied window. The schedule's own start_date, end_date, title, summary and existing moments are unchanged. Free text or a multipart document switches to the AI addition path. Responds 201 with the schedule but no moments.

bodyFields.name: startDate
bodyFields.description: First day for the new moments.

bodyFields.name: endDate
bodyFields.description: Last day for the new moments; must not precede startDate.

bodyFields.name: medications
bodyFields.description: One or more {drug, dose, frequency, times[]} entries; same schema as create.

bodyFields.name: document
bodyFields.description: multipart/form-data alternative for the AI path; not embedded here.

responses.label: Created
responses.description: Schedule with both medications; new moments are not included.

schedule.title: Headache relief plan
schedule.summary: Paracetamol 500 mg up to three times daily for two days

endpoints.curl:
TOKEN="<access-jwt>"
SCHEDULE_ID=<schedule-id>
curl -sS -X PATCH http://localhost:3000/v1/medications/$SCHEDULE_ID/add \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"startDate":"2026-11-17","endDate":"2026-11-18","medications":[{"drug":"Ibuprofen","dose":"200 mg","frequency":"Twice daily","times":[{"hour":9,"minute":30},{"hour":21,"minute":30}]}]}'
notes: Returns 201, not 200, because new moments are created.
The captured response still shows the schedule's original dates (2026-11-17T00:00:00.000Z and 2026-11-19T00:00:00.000Z); only medications and moments were extended.
Re-adding an existing drug appends a second entry; it does not merge times.

endpoints.name: Remove a medication from a schedule
endpoints.summary: Remove a drug and delete its still-PENDING dose moments.
endpoints.description: Matches drug case-insensitively after trimming, removes it from the schedule's medications array and deletes its PENDING moments, optionally only those at or after from. TAKEN and MISSED moments are retained. Returns the schedule without moments.

bodyFields.name: drug
bodyFields.description: Drug name to remove; case-insensitive, whitespace-trimmed.

bodyFields.name: from
bodyFields.description: Optional ISO date; only PENDING moments at or after it are deleted.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Schedule with only Paracetamol remaining.

schedule.title: Headache relief plan
schedule.summary: Paracetamol 500 mg up to three times daily for two days

endpoints.curl:
TOKEN="<access-jwt>"
SCHEDULE_ID=<schedule-id>
curl -sS -X PATCH http://localhost:3000/v1/medications/$SCHEDULE_ID/remove \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"drug":"Ibuprofen"}'
notes: Removing a drug that is not present leaves the medication list unchanged and still returns 200.
The response omits moments; re-fetch GET /medications/:id to confirm deletions.

endpoints.name: Register a device push token
endpoints.summary: Upsert an FCM token for the signed-in account.
endpoints.description: Upserts by token: repeat calls update account owner, platform and last_used_at. FCM is disabled in this environment (FCM_ENABLED=false), so registration stores the token but no push is delivered.

bodyFields.name: token
bodyFields.description: FCM registration token, 1-4096 characters.

bodyFields.name: platform
bodyFields.description: IOS, ANDROID or WEB (uppercase enum).

responses.label: Created
responses.description: Device id and platform; the token is not echoed.

endpoints.curl:
TOKEN="<access-jwt>"
curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:3000/v1/devices \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"token":"demo-web-token-7f3c9a2e","platform":"WEB"}'
notes: Requires authentication but no patient profile.
Response is {device:{id,platform}}; keep the token client-side, it is not returned.

endpoints.name: Delete a medication schedule
endpoints.summary: Delete a schedule and cascade its moments.
endpoints.description: Deletes the schedule row for the authenticated patient; moments cascade via the database relation. Returns {message} or 404 not_found when no row matches.

responses.label: OK
responses.description: Deletion confirmed.

notes: The captured schedules (structured and AI-assisted) were deleted after capture; GET /medications returned total 0.
